title: Phineas
summary: Raleigh names Phineas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Phineas, the sonne of Eleazar. The same paragraph also says the five Midianite princes were slaine by Eleazar. Both names were attached as printed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. IX, sig. 206a
